name: Neeka Bloodscar
summary: Helgrum the Swift sends you from Stonard to the Badlands outpost of Kargath, to speak with its head scout, Neeka Bloodscar. Word between Stonard and Kargath is often cut.

sections.title: A Cut Line
sections.body: The Badlands are harsh country and lie close to Loch Modan, which the Alliance holds. Because of this, word between Stonard and Kargath is often cut. Helgrum asks you to prove yourself by travelling to the Badlands and speaking with Neeka Bloodscar, who is head scout there. Neeka's report is then to be sent back to Helgrum.

sections.title: Neeka's Answer
sections.body: Neeka tells you an outrunner was sent toward Stonard barely three days earlier. If Stonard has nothing from Neeka, that runner must have failed. Neeka hopes the next one has more skill, or more luck.

faq.q: Where does Helgrum the Swift send you?
faq.answer: From Stonard to the outpost of Kargath in the Badlands, to speak with Neeka Bloodscar.

faq.q: Why is communication between Stonard and Kargath cut off?
faq.answer: The Badlands are harsh and lie close to Loch Modan, which the Alliance holds, and word between Stonard and Kargath is often cut.
Neeka Bloodscar is the head scout of the Kargath outpost in the Badlands.

faq.q: What comes after speaking with Neeka Bloodscar?
